ops.body: - **NV16 and NV17 in the concept doc after G17** (Nov 27; decisions 0273, 0275, specs/current-position). The repo's mirror `specs/navigation-and-tabs/spec.md` (last exported Nov 3) now carries both amended, with "Was:"; the doc's "Navigation & tabs (spec draft)" tab still says the old, and wins a re-export. The wording for the doc: NV16, "Explore's drawer peeks with the area in view and opens to its busy streets and places to find. Explore never tracks you: it reads one fresh fix each time it comes to the front (its tab's focus, or the app's return to the front), by itself while location is allowed and asking only at its first front in a launch, and lists and frames from it; between reads nothing watches. With no fix read it lists where it last listed, drawing no dot and saying no walk time from you." NV17, append to "re-read each time the tab comes to the front": "and when the app returns to the front while location is allowed". The doc is the owner's to change.
